key_fields.organization: colonies of 2-8 cells, rarely as single cells

narrative.morphology: Colonies of 4-30 spherical cells that remain attached after cell division (Plate 1, 2). With wide colorless translucent gelatinous slime (Plates 1, 2). With envelopes around cells. No gas vacuoles.
narrative.environmental_conditions: Chroococcus limneticus was more abundant at warmer water temperatures, lower alkalinities, and higher pH – to a limit of pH 9.0 (Fig. 2).
